title: User can frontrun `completeGame` to finalize stake or unstake request
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  Staking user can frontrun `Flip.completeGame()` and finalize his stake/unstake request (based on game result loss or win):  ```solidity     function finalizeUnstake(address token) external nonReentrant {         UnstakeRequest memory request = unstakeRequests[token][msg.sender];         uint256 sharesToRedeem = request.shares;         require(sharesToRedeem > 0, "No unstake request found");         require(block.timestamp >= request.requestTime + unstakeDelay, "Unstake delay not passed");         --snipp--     } ```  ```s
